title: Provenance record
description: One line of a provenance/*.jsonl manifest. 'source' records describe a third-party file exactly as fetched (re-fetchable from download_url). 'derived' records describe a file our pipeline produced, pointing at the ids of its inputs. audit.py enforces this schema (a stdlib subset) plus licences.json.

licence.description: SPDX id or LicenseRef-*; must be in licences.json allow or note.

licence_note.description: Required when licences.json lists the licence under 'note'.

attribution.description: Exact CREDITS.md line. Required when the licence needs attribution.

download_url.description: URL the file was fetched from (no credentials).

retrieved_or_built.description: ISO date of download (source) or build (derived).

path.description: Path relative to the data root (data/), e.g. raw/audio/freesound/205748/x.wav or build/audio/...

status.description: Quality gate outcome. Rejected sources may not be inputs of derived records.

inputs.description: derived only: ids of input records.

tool.description: derived only: tool names and versions, script path, parameters, seed.

synthetic_placeholder.description: True when an input is a stand-in (e.g. synthetic IR) that must be replaced before shipping.
